objective: Define the minimum boundary for connecting a Verilator-facing native invocation process to the existing sidecar launcher CLI after the structured launcher invocation run review, without implementing or executing that connection in this gate.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted predecessor proves that reviewed metadata can start run_hybrid_template.py and reach compare, but it still does not prove that a Verilator-facing process can safely hand off to that launcher. The missing boundary is the authority chain from process parser payload to launcher CLI argv, not another template-run result.
reason: the predecessor review accepted only structured launcher invocation evidence
the predecessor review records full_native_verilator_process_to_launcher_cli_exists as false
the next useful step is defining the exact authority and failure classes for a Verilator-facing process-to-launcher CLI connection
coverage_output_equivalence remains the scoped correctness policy only after a later reviewed run reaches compare

failure_class_boundary.process_parse_failure: the Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: the parser payload exists but target, template or registry entry, source gate, or shape context is missing or ambiguous
failure_class_boundary.source_or_template_authority_failure: the sidecar context lacks reviewed source closure or reviewed template authority for the requested target and shape
failure_class_boundary.process_to_launcher_cli_bridge_failure: the process payload cannot be converted into the exact structured launcher CLI argv
failure_class_boundary.launcher_cli_invocation_failure: the structured launcher CLI argv is built but cannot safely start or complete the launcher process
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the launcher starts, but a scoped build or run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_process_to_launcher_cli_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the boundary is narrow enough for a future process-to-launcher CLI implementation
whether parser schedule, sidecar context, source or template authority, launcher argv, and compare policy stay separate
whether the failure classes are precise enough to avoid hiding parser, bridge, launcher, stage, compare, and timing failures
whether the boundary avoids treating structured run_hybrid_template.py evidence as direct Verilator sidecar execution
whether generated reports and artifacts remain noncanonical
must_not_claim: process-to-launcher CLI implementation by this definition gate

non_claims: not broad native Verilator option support
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
